plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's mind. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
This person has a way of stretching your thinking past its comfort zone.

They may see opportunity where you see risk, possibility where you see unanswered questions. Their instinct is often to go bigger, faster, further. At times, that can feel inspiring. At other times, it can feel like they are skipping over the practical realities that matter to you.

This connection often highlights the tension between vision and discernment. They may challenge assumptions you did not realize you were carrying. They may push against limits that have become so familiar you mistake them for facts. Around them, you may discover that some of your caution comes from wisdom, while some of it comes from fear.

When this dynamic is working well, they help you expand your sense of what is possible. They encourage you to think beyond the version of the story you have already accepted. They remind you that growth rarely happens inside the boundaries of certainty.

The challenge is separating real possibility from wishful thinking. They tend to expand. You tend to question. If you are not careful, one person becomes the visionary and the other becomes the skeptic.

At its best, this connection creates balance. They help you see beyond your usual limits, and you help turn possibility into something workable. Their vision gives the idea room to grow. Your discernment helps it take shape.
